source_refs.note: Topic 5.2.2 (PDF 128-129, printed 125-126). The book gives the mean as 75.5; the ten scores add to 758, so the mean is 75.8. Short question 4 is answered. Recorded.

blocks.text: Descriptive statistics summarize and organize data so we see the overall picture instead of every value. Ten students scored 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 and 88. Their mean is (50 + 65 + 75 + 80 + 85 + 90 + 95 + 60 + 70 + 88) / 10 = 758 / 10 = 75.8; the highest score is 95 and the lowest 50.

blocks.prompt: How does visualizing data help in understanding descriptive statistics (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: A chart shows at a glance what the numbers summarize: a histogram shows where most values lie and how spread out they are, a boxplot shows the median, quartiles and outliers, and a bar or line chart compares means or shows trends. Patterns, unusual values and differences between groups become obvious without reading every number.

items: Descriptive statistics summarize data: for the ten scores, mean 75.8, highest 95, lowest 50.
